description.zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。

- 最大值：50
- 默认值：50
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return per page.

- Maximum value: 50

- Default value: 50

description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.
The name of the automatic snapshot policy.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. To query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service, call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation.
